name: eduport-lead-touch
description: Eduport Lead Touch & Conversion analytics (Postgres + Cloudflare Workers + React)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix sync install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix sync run typecheck
scripts.db:all: for f in sql/00[1-6]*.sql; do psql "$ADMIN_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f $f || exit 1; done
scripts.db:analytics: psql "$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/002_functions.sql -f sql/003_views.sql -f sql/004_matviews.sql -f sql/006_data_quality.sql && psql "$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" -f sql/005_indexes.sql
